Team —

Quick note ahead of the forecast close: finance asked us to run a targeted stage reset in EMEA and APAC to make the March rollup cleaner. This is a short sweep to confirm which deals are true commits versus soft pipeline. Please do the following by EOD Friday Feb 26: 

1) Run the attached stage-reset template for your deals in EMEA/APAC. Populate: current stage, most likely amount, firm close date (or "No-go"), and one-line reason if stage changes.
2) For any deal you mark as "Commit", add the evidence link in the template (email thread, legal LOI, signed SOW, procurement PO).
3) Update HubSpot close probability to reflect the reset (and leave a 1-line note in the deal timeline).

Highlights / rules: 
- Only mark "Commit" if procurement/legal have an explicit next step (LS signature scheduled, PO issued, or C-level verbal).
- If the customer is in Legal but negotiations are active without a near-term signature, mark as "Late Pipeline" / No-go for this sweep.
- If you expect a legitimate close in the next 7 days but no docs yet, flag as "Pending Approval" and put a date + what is blocking.

I'm attaching two templates: a small Excel to upload and a CSV if you want to paste. Rishi — can you coordinate APAC sweep and aggregate into the APAC_commit_log? Jonas / Laura — please run EMEA and ping me with any borderline ones. Vivek, I know you have a couple of large renewals; highlight those so finance can treat separately (possible carve-outs).

This will feed into a short leadership commit review Mon morning. If you can't hit Friday EOD, reply with the list of deals you can't finish and why.

Thanks — Steph
